title: Reward Points Earned over the Year, Added to the Share Relieved on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Fee
content:
The year's earning is then added. Where the membership stands active and the reward points it has earned in the last twelve months come to the high spend points or more, the high spend share is added. Where the membership stands active and those points come to the mid spend points or more but fewer than the high spend points, the mid spend share is added. In any other case nothing is added.

The high spend points are 6000. The mid spend points are 2500. The high spend share is 10 per cent. The mid spend share is 5 per cent.

## What is read

The points read are the reward points accrued on the customer's Northbeam Circle Membership over the last twelve months, taken from that membership's ledger, and the membership must stand active. What is added is added to the share relieved against the Northbeam Returns and Restocking fee still standing.

| The membership | Reward points earned in the last twelve months | Share added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | 6000 or more | 10 per cent |
| active | 2500 or more but fewer than 6000 | 5 per cent |
| active | fewer than 2500 | nothing |
| not active | any number | nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical inputs

*A membership standing active having earned 6000 points in the last twelve months.* Six thousand is 6000 or more, so 10 per cent is added.

*A membership standing active having earned 5999 points.* That is fewer than 6000 and 2500 or more, so 5 per cent is added.

*A membership standing active having earned exactly 2500 points.* Two thousand five hundred is 2500 or more, so 5 per cent is added.

*A membership standing active having earned 2499 points.* That is fewer than 2500, so nothing is added.

*A lapsed membership having earned 9000 points in the last twelve months.* It does not stand active, so nothing is added.
